title: COMPUTER ORGANIZATION AND ASSEMBLY PROGRAMMING
description: Explores computer organization, how major components in a computer system function together in executing a program, and assembly language.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: ECE 204 or 271.
A minimum grade of C is required in ECE 204 and ECE 271.
meeting_html: W 2pm-3:50pm in DEAR 203 - Dearborn Hall 203 (9/23 to 12/4)
